Definition: a primary verb (compare G4428); to spit:--spit.
BiblicalUsage: Ptuo means to spit. Jesus spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and anointed the eyes of the blind man; He took the deaf man aside, and put His fingers into his ears, and He spit, and touched his tongue; and He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the town, and when He had spit on his eyes, He asked him if he saw ought.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that His spittle is the strangest medicine in the Bible: dust and spit made clay, and clay made eyes see, because the hands that mixed it were the hands that made Adam.
